_doc: Hardcoded global top-banned champions for the champ-select Suggestions panel.
Operator-editable: bump the patch field + reorder the list whenever the meta shifts.
The endpoint /api/champ-select/ban-suggestions reads this file on each call
(no caching - load is sub-millisecond) and filters against already-banned champions.
Currently a single global list - per-role refinement is a follow-up.
Champion names match data/meta/ddragon_champions.json display-name spelling
(spaces + apostrophes preserved). The backend tolerantly resolves slug variants.
